note: Calibration runbook (docs/product/14-calibration-runbook.md) §2: 30 hypotheses, 10 real-effect / 8 planted-null / 8 confound-trap / 4 underpowered, kind order shuffled so no three consecutive hypotheses share a kind. Every seed is pinned here rather than derived, because §2 asks for fixed seeds RECORDED UP FRONT: the manifest is the record. Each seed was chosen as the first in its scenario's own block (h01 from 1001, h02 from 2001, …) whose sample actually carries its kind's trap under go/hypolab's two reference estimators — hypolabgen -verify re-proves that on every run and refuses if it stops holding. Sample sizes are the smallest that keep the traps sharp while keeping one CSV inside a sane prompt: a 400-row dataset is roughly 7 KB of event text.
